reviewed_route_classes.blocking_reason: Reviewed direct S2 evidence now spans benchmark-scaffolded organizations and two external first-party native product boundaries. Nool and The Specification Gap supply two benchmark-scaffolded direct non-canonical observations. CodeCRDT supplies a descriptive direct non-canonical observation at its own native product boundary. Grit supplies a first-party direct non-canonical product-boundary observation from a committed synthetic merge-contention sweep, but generated per-run result directories are gitignored and the raw-git/Grit arms sample work allocation separately, so the row remains partially matched rather than independently reproduced or primary-quality. Twining qualifies as a direct family but lacks recoverable exact treatment revision. CooperBench qualifies as a direct family but its committed 50-pair report is generated from flash run logs that are not pinned in the reviewed repository, so no CooperBench observation row is admitted.
The published ablations exercise native coordination mechanisms but score broad task/collaboration outcomes rather than an explicit interaction-generated disturbance and its attenuation.
The compared organization is benchmark-authored and/or deliberately removes recurring inter-S1 interference, so matched cost/quality/runtime rows are not direct S2 capability evidence.

Canonical S2 mechanisms exist, but current public result surfaces do not exercise them as direct native disturbance-to-attenuation capability observations. C.A.D.I.S. and ARES were explicitly re-reviewed in post-closure delta issue #592; Shep and Axocoatl were reviewed after their canonical admissions in issue #626; Lime was reviewed after admission in issue #657. Lime's limiter tests and AgentControl Gate B evidence establish admission/lifecycle invariants rather than a direct contention-to-attenuation capability result.
The adapter/benchmark design is structurally promising, but the public leaderboard does not yet contain the multi-orchestrator result rows needed for a matched canonical cell.

closure_claim: Current public evidence contains eight direct S2 disturbance/attenuation families, four direct non-canonical observations, and two native quantitative S2 proxy projections. CodeCRDT and Grit expand direct evidence to external first-party native product boundaries, but the current reviewed canonical cohort, now including Lime, still contains no canonical native direct observation and no matched canonical-harness S2 primary cell.
reopen_when: a canonical S2 harness publishes an explicit native inter-S1 disturbance-to-attenuation result
a materially matched benchmark evaluates two or more canonical systems exercising their own native or adapter-preserved S2 paths under one disturbance definition
MAO-Bench or a comparable benchmark publishes recoverable multi-orchestrator results with immutable system/model/configuration provenance and direct S2 semantics
do_not_reopen_for: another benchmark-scaffolded direct S2 observation without canonical native or adapter-preserved linkage
another external-native non-canonical S2 observation without canonical linkage or a matched canonical comparison cell
another broad collaboration or task-success score without an explicit S2 disturbance
another topology or framework benchmark whose coordination organization is benchmark-authored
another communication or token-efficiency metric without disturbance-to-attenuation closure
non_claim: This closure is not a zero S2 capability score and does not downgrade canonical S2 ownership. Nool and The Specification Gap provide direct evidence only for their benchmark-defined organizations. CodeCRDT and Grit provide direct evidence for their own external native product boundaries but have no canonical Index identity. CodeCRDT lacks a matched uncoordinated-parallel control; Grit's selected sweep is first-party-reported, partially matched and lacks committed per-run result directories. Twining and CooperBench contribute direct-family coverage without admitted observations for their recorded provenance reasons. Lime contributes a canonical constructor S2 mechanism without a direct capability observation. The S2 primary remains frozen until materially new canonical native or matched evidence appears.
